item.title: Rock climber falls 40 to 50 feet on Red Rock multipitch; seven-hour rescue conducted
item.description: Search and Rescue conducted a complex, seven-hour-long rescue after a rock climber fell an estimated 40 to 50 feet in Red Rock Canyon on Saturday, according to Las Vegas police.

item.title: Las Vegas father comes forward after Spy Ninjas accident
item.description: Following 8 News Now's release of a shocking video of a 10-year-old plummeting to the ground while riding an indoor zip line at Spy Ninjas HQ, another man has now come forward claiming he was also hurt at the same park in October.

item.title: Boulder City pilot dies in small airplane crash in Utah Saturday morning, NTSB says
item.description: A pilot from Boulder City was killed in a plane crash Saturday morning near the Nevada-Utah border, according to information from the National Transportation Safety Board.

item.title: Victims scammed by Las Vegas contractor start to get repaid as trial looms
item.description: The trial scheduled for a contractor accused of scamming dozens of victims has been postponed, but his victims are starting to get paid by the state.

item.title: Las Vegas mother, son plead guilty in $5 million tax fraud scheme
item.description: A Las Vegas woman and her son conspired to defraud the IRS of $5 million in false tax returns filed over a five-year span. Both entered guilty pleas on Monday in federal court.
